 Career 3832 Postdoc Position in Quantum Control of Semiconductor Qubits 
Join the Veldhorst Group, pioneers in germanium-based quantum computing and simulation. Job description 
After a successful first hire for this research topic, we are looking for a second Postdoctoral Researcher to join the Veldhorst Group, who are pioneers in quantum computing and simulation in germanium. The Veldhorst group demonstrated the first single-hole qubit, enabled two-qubit logic in germanium, and executed quantum algorithms on a four-qubit quantum processor. 
As a Postdoc researcher, you will explore opportunities with semiconductor quantum technology and aim to push the boundaries in quantum control of semiconductor qubits. 
The Veldhorst group is a collaborative and supportive research environment where team members work closely together, share expertise, and mentor one another while advancing the field of semiconductor quantum technology. 
Near-term projects include multi-qubit operation, entanglement generation between qubit registers, and multi-quantum wells for higher dimensional quantum systems. Requirements 
You have a PhD degree in physics, applied physics, nanoelectronics or comparable discipline at the time of taking on the position. Prior experience in solid-state quantum computing, spin qubits, or superconducting qubits would be beneficial but is not required. 
Doing a Postdoc at TU Delft requires English proficiency at a certain level to ensure that the candidate is able to communicate and interact well, participate in English-taught Doctoral Education courses, and write scientific articles and a final thesis. For more details please check the Graduate Schools Admission Requirements.

Front Office Internship - January 2026
Is it time for you to start searching for an internship, do you breathe hospitality and are you more than excited to broaden your knowledge, stop with your search! As our Front Office Intern at Park Plaza Utrecht you are located in the heart of the hotel. The place to gain an enormous amount of experience, which will support you in improving and outing your passion for great service. The Front of House team will go beyond to teach you the ins and outs of this wonderful job, because eventually we enjoy watching you grow and inspire!
As a Front Office Intern you will receive:

• €550 internship allowance
• Tasty and healthy meal during your shift 
• Exciting job opportunities within PPHE Hotel Group across Europe
• Discounted hotel rates (extends to the Radisson Hotel Group worldwide and family & friends)
• 50% F&B discount at our restaurants and bars (for your whole party)
• Annual company parties and outings
• Exclusive discounts in the employee benefit store (www.vipvoordeelwinkel.nl)
• Great (online) Learning & Development opportunities to grow your career

and more…
Are you the perfect match for Front Office Intern?

• You aim for a warm welcome and smooth check-in and check-out procedure for all our guests
• You actively think about solving guests' issues and would love to learn how to provide advice and give recommendations. Thereby you look for ways to improve our Front of House services
• You like to stretch yourself through new challenges and different ways of working
• You listen and adapt to the needs of both, guests and team members.
• Friendly, calm and constructive is what people around you are saying about your personality 
• You strive to deliver an individualised service that creates a brilliant first impression and will exceed their expectations throughout their stay
• You posses a good command of English and has excellent communication skills
• Hospitality is in your DNA!
• You share our values: Trust

Become a Production Worker in a friendly team! You work day shifts, have weekends off, earn a gross hourly wage of € 14.99, and get 29 vacation days. Housing and transportation are arranged so you can start worry-free. Add more color to your work! 
About the job 
As a Production Worker, you mainly work in the bottling department. Here, cans and buckets are filled with paint using filling machines. You set up and operate filling machines, fill paint in various packages, and check the filling process. You work day shifts from Monday to Thursday from 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM and on Friday from 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM. You have breaks from 10:00 to 10:15 AM, 12:30 to 1:00 PM, and 3:00 to 3:15 PM. Together with your colleagues, you ensure a clean workplace and support the shipping department when needed. What you will do: - Set up and operate filling machines; - Fill paint into different packages; - Check the filling process; - Support with labeling and preparing orders for shipment; - Keep the workplace tidy; - Help the shipping department when necessary. 
What we offer - A gross hourly wage of € 14.99; - 8% holiday pay; - 29 vacation days per year; - Pension accrual via Flexdirect; - Housing and transportation via Flexdirect; - Travel allowance of € 0.23 per km from 5 km up to a maximum of 40 km one way; - Work in a fixed day shift schedule with weekends off. 
What we ask - You speak Dutch or English; - You are at least 18 years old; - You are motivated and enjoy working in a team; - Experience in production is helpful but not required.
